outcome: women's decision-making process regarding mode of delivery after cesarean section
cohort: Pregnant women in Turkey who were deciding on the mode of delivery after a previous cesarean section.
finding: The primary finding was that women perceived an inability to control their decision-making process regarding mode of delivery after a previous cesarean section.
mod_finding: Findings related to mode of birth indicated that repeat cesarean section experiences were defined as traumatic, while vaginal birth after cesarean experiences were defined as an achievement providing strength and pride.
